LXGW WenKai Regular, unmodified original TTF (LXGWWenKai-Regular.ttf). Not packaged in the app.

Source: https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai
Commit: 8bd6319350fb3ae1904c1cb1a41595ab15d21140
License: SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL.txt); the notice is also bundled in APK assets/licenses.
SHA256: 39ad71264b588165b469e35e6afb162a378dacd1f95348160240ba9038ac3009

The app bundles a subset generated by subset.py at app/src/main/res/font/bundled_kai_regular.ttf: all non-ideograph
glyphs, the GB2312 and Big5 common ideographs, and every ideograph used by the app's own text. As a Modified Version it
is renamed "Bundled Kai", because the OFL reserves the original font names. Rerun subset.py after changing UI text if
FontCoverageTest reports missing characters.
